text: Harper and Harper Audio present Pete the Cat and the Sprinkle Stealer by Kimberly and James Dean. You know, secret agent Meow. He's also known as Pete the Cat. You've got a new case, secret agent Meow. Not that blasted agent Claw again. That evil cat robot. What is he up to now? Meow's new case hits close to home. Agent Claw stole our recipe for rainbow sprinkle cookies. The big baking contest is tomorrow. With that recipe, he'll win it all. Don't Meow tracks agent Claw with the cat track 2000. Hmm, these lead to Gus's house. Agent Meow, I'm making banana bread for the contest, but my sugar is gone. How strange, and the secret recipe isn't here either. Gus, you haven't seen agent Claw, have you? No, I haven't, but I did find this. He pointed to a line of white crystals. Aha, a sugar trail. Don't worry, my ant bots can follow this no problem. Look, it leads to Callie's house. Agent Meow, I'm baking cupcakes for the contest, but my rainbow sprinkles are gone. And there's no secret recipe hidden in here either. Gulp. Let me just finish this cupcake. Callie, have you seen agent Claw? No, I haven't, but look at this trail. Callie pointed to a trail of rainbow sprinkles. I'll use the sprinkle scanner to see where they go. The sprinkle scanner detected the rainbow sprinkles immediately. The sprinkles are leading me to Grumpy Toad's house. Why so grouchy, Grumpy Toad? I'm baking brownies for the contest, but my chocolate chips are gone. All of a sudden, there was a loud beeping. Agent Meow, I detect chocolate chips nearby. There they are. I'll use the chip-o-meter to follow their trail. Agent Meow, I'm baking apple pie for the baking contest, but my butter is gone. Agent Claw strikes again. Squirrel, have you seen him? No, but I did hear a strange beeping earlier. I'll see if I can hear the beeping with my Mega Meow. Beep, beep, beep. I think I've got something. The Mega Meow led me straight to Agent Claw. Using his jetpack, secret Agent Meow followed Agent Claw from the air. Agent Claw pushes a button that opens a secret door. That must be Agent Claw's secret lair. Super seers activate. Snap, click, zoop. What's he up to now? Secret Agent Meow went into the lair and saw the secret recipe for the rainbow chocolate chip cookies on a device labeled to self-destruct. Look, there it is, the secret recipe and all the ingredients too. Agent Claw was looking at screens that showed his evil plan, steal formula, bake amazing cookies, win it all. Gotcha, Claw. Hand over the recipe. You're too late. I've already said it to self-destruct. If I can't have the recipe, no one can. Claw spilled flower everywhere, exiting in a giant white cloud of flower. Agent Meow springs into action. Five, four, three, two, not on my watch. Agent Meow grabbed giant wire cutters and cut the self-destruct. Got it. Deactivated. Later, Claw got away, but I found the recipe and all your missing stuff. Yay! Secret Agent Meow closes another case. Thank you, Secret Agent Meow. Solving this case was extra sweet. And now I'm going to take another bite of this rainbow cookie. Case closed. We hope you've enjoyed this unabridged production of Pete the Cat and the Sprinkle Stealer. By Kimberly and James Dean. Performed by James Fowey. And directed by Cynthia Lee. Presented by Harper and Harper Audio. This program was produced by John Marshall Media. Executive producer, Almeida Baynut. Text copyright 2022 by Kimberly and James Dean. Production copyright 2022 by Harper Collins Publishers. All rights reserved. Thank you for listening.
